title: Ocarina of Time
summary: A progression-aware Japanese vocabulary course organized around the major stages of the adventure.

chapterModel.description: Chapters follow durable story and dungeon milestones. Later adult chapters expose prerequisites and a recommended order because some objectives can be completed nonlinearly.
chapterModel.assignmentRule: A vocabulary note belongs to the earliest chapter where it is needed and is tagged with every later chapter where it appears.
chapterModel.deckLayout: JP Assist::Ocarina of Time::NN Chapter title

audio.description: Decks remain fully usable without audio. Only reviewed, commercially usable local or free generation may populate the optional word and sentence audio fields.

chapters.title: The Boy Without a Fairy
chapters.subtitle: Kokiri Forest and the Great Deku Tree
chapters.scope: Opening conversations, forest navigation, obtaining basic equipment, and the first dungeon.

deck.description: A small reviewed sample proves the content and export format before full corpus assignment.

sampleCards.sentenceJapanese: 深い森では、古い精霊が旅人の道を守っている。
sampleCards.sentenceEnglish: In the deep forest, an ancient spirit guards the traveler's path.

sampleCards.sentenceJapanese: 小さな妖精が月明かりの道を照らした。
sampleCards.sentenceEnglish: A tiny fairy lit the moonlit path.

sampleCards.sentenceJapanese: 若い騎士は石の台から古い剣を持ち上げた。
sampleCards.sentenceEnglish: The young knight lifted an old sword from the stone pedestal.

sampleCards.sentenceJapanese: 木の盾には森を守る紋章が刻まれている。
sampleCards.sentenceEnglish: The wooden shield bears a crest that protects the forest.

sampleCards.sentenceJapanese: 勇気があれば、暗い洞窟にも進める。
sampleCards.sentenceEnglish: With courage, you can venture into a dark cavern.

sampleCards.sentenceJapanese: 朝の鐘が鳴ると、眠っていた守り手が目覚めた。
sampleCards.sentenceEnglish: When the morning bell rang, the sleeping guardian awoke.
